Players Committee card image of [[Zam Wesell (ALT)]] (original printing), game text: “Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots. If alone, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. If opponent's leader just lost from same site, opponent loses 2 Force. If just lost, may search your Force Pile and take any one card into hand; reshuffle.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/zamwesell_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/f2597ee807811560eceafe2565f2fecb71a83308 f2597ee] (8 November 2023). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
